name: Phandalin
summary: Rebuilt frontier village of farmers, woodcutters, trappers and prospectors in the Lost Hills of the Sword Mountains, resettled from about 1486 DR on the ruins of a 10th-century town; about fifty log and flagstone buildings in 1491 DR.

identity.subregion: Lost Hills of the Sword Mountains, south of Neverwinter Wood, north-east of Leilon
identity.ruler_office: Annually elected Townmaster (Harbin Wester, 1491 DR); three-member Town Council from the early 1490s DR, year not given

periods.snapshot_5e: 1491 DR (Lost Mine of Phandelver), early 1490s DR (Dragon of Icespire Peak, In Volo's Wake), 1496 DR (Acquisitions Incorporated)
periods.note: Nothing is verified for 1492 DR itself; 1496 DR details come after the baseline.

position.note: Taken from the 2026-10-01 review of maps/locations.json; not a canonical georeference. The engine trail to Triboar is 86.5 miles against about 225 in the sources (T16, P13).

engine_record.population_note: Gazetteer estimate with no reference year; no source gives a count. About 50 structures in 1491 DR suggest roughly 160 to 240 in the town core before farms and claims (P10).

town_plan.source: Map of Phandalin, Lost Mine of Phandelver (D&D Starter Set, 2014), p. 17, by Mike Schley
town_plan.scale: Bar from 0 to 500 feet (marks at 20, 50, 100 and 200)
town_plan.building_count_note: Text gives about fifty structures (Lost Mine of Phandelver, p. 14); not counted from the plan.
layout: Town green at the centre, with roads radiating north-east (to the Triboar Trail), east (main street to Tresendar Manor) and south-west (Miners' Trail)
Edermath Orchard on the north-west edge
Tresendar Manor on a wooded hill east of town, at the end of the main street
Alderleaf Farm fields on the south-east edge
Miner's Exchange on the south-west, beside the Miners' Trail
uncertain_readings: The Smithy appears on the 2014 plan but is staffed only in the 1496 DR source
The wells are not marked on the plan

interactive_map_markers.source: Forgotten Realms Wiki "Map:Phandalin (1491 DR)", drawn on an unlabelled copy of the Lost Mine of Phandelver plan (File:Phandalin-Background, 4000 by 2788)
interactive_map_markers.coordinates: Origin bottom left, x then y, in the map's own units (0 to 4000 by 0 to 2788, equal to the background image's pixels); larger x is east and larger y is north (inferred from the orchard to the west, Tresendar Manor to the east and the Triboar road to the north); no scale

markers.note: 1491 DR; closed late 1495 or early 1496 DR
Waukeen, 1496 DR; in the former Barthen's Provisions building

interactive_map_markers.note: The wiki says the positions come from two sources; the second (adding the Smithy and the 1496 DR temple) is probably Acquisitions Incorporated but was not confirmed. A References marker at (3999, 0) is omitted.

display_map.provenance: Supplied by the project owner. The image names no publisher, artist, edition or date. It is a repainted version of the Lost Mine of Phandelver plan with the same labels.
conflicts_with_sources: Sister Garaele's home is not labelled
Adds a stream along the south and east edges, crossed by a footbridge, that the published plan does not show
Adds ploughed field strips and a well at Alderleaf Farm

sketch.method: Interactive-map marker positions scaled by 0.225 with y flipped; roads, orchard, farm fields and manor hill placed by eye; houses not drawn
sketch.status: Working reconstruction, not a copy of the published map
